codex_gpt55.auth_hint: Run `codex login` (ChatGPT account) or export OPENAI_API_KEY. Verify model id with `codex exec -m gpt-5.5 'say ok'`.

claude_code_opus48.auth_hint: Run `claude` once to log in with the Max-plan account (or `claude setup-token`).

opencode_glm52.auth_hint: Run `opencode auth login` and pick the Zhipu/Z.AI provider; confirm the exact model id with `opencode models | grep -i glm`.

gemini_cli_35flash.auth_hint: Run `gemini` once for the Google OAuth flow, or export GEMINI_API_KEY.

opencode_minimax_m3.auth_hint: Run `opencode auth login` and pick MiniMax; confirm the exact model id with `opencode models | grep -i minimax`.

opencode_deepseek_v4.auth_hint: Run `opencode auth login` and pick DeepSeek; confirm the exact model id with `opencode models | grep -i deepseek`.

opencode_kimi_k27code.auth_hint: Moonshot platform key registered under the `moonshotai` provider (not `kimi-for-coding`); confirm with `opencode models | grep -i moonshot`.
